notes.title: Full version will be released next week
notes.notes:
Ahoy, fellow Vikings! 

Ancient Saga: Vikings Journey is nearly ready to set sail! Sharpen your axes, for April 19th marks the day the full version will be unleashed upon the world!

Embark on a heroic adventure, featuring 50 daring new levels, 5 legendary locations, and the riveting conclusion to the saga of Thor and Fenrir! 

Skål to you, our loyal warriors, for standing by us!
